data.value: Excuse me, Mr. {0}. Where is my lost item?

data.value: Your lost item? It's not here, that's for sure.

data.value: Huh?

data.name: CH3_S1_Azurill_5
data.value: My...big brother...

data.value: Nope. Your big brother's not coming.

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_4
data.value: I'll let you in on a little secret. This was all a trick.[pause=0] I deceived you.

data.name: CH3_S1_Azurill_7
data.value: Huh?!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_5
data.value: But let's not dwell on that. There's a little favor I need to ask.

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_6
data.value: See that hole behind you?

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_7
data.value: Well...

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_8
data.value: There's a rumor that there's a trove of thief treasure inside there!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_9
data.value: But as you can see, I'm too big to squirm my way through that hole.

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_10
data.value: And that's where you come in!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_11
data.value: Don't worry. Just do as I say.

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_12
data.value: Do that, then I'll help you get back out of there.

data.name: CH3_S1_Azurill_8
data.value: B-but...

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_13
data.value: Go on, get going!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_14
data.value: Go into that hole. And don't forget to bring back the treasure!

data.name: CH3_S1_Azurill_9
data.value: I want my big brother!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_15
data.value: H-hey! Stop that!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_16
data.value: Sheesh! I said that I'll take you home when you're done!

data.name: CH3_S1_Drowzee_17
data.value: If you keep being difficult, it will mean big trouble for you!

data.name: CH3_S1_Azurill_10
data.value: H-h-h...HELP!
